name: Adobe Real-Time CDP
description: Adobe Real-Time CDP unifies customer profiles, datasets, identities, audiences, governance, and activation on Adobe Experience Platform.
agentUseSummary: Connect customer-owned OAuth Server-to-Server credentials bound to one organization and sandbox. Relay mounts three bounded GET operations: dataset metadata runs directly, while audience definitions and one exact profile require approval.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_REAL_TIME_CDP_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned OAuth Server-to-Server credential.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_REAL_TIME_CDP_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay sends this only to Adobe's fixed IMS token endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_REAL_TIME_CDP_SCOPES
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe OAuth scopes
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the least-privilege scopes assigned to the server-to-server credential.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_REAL_TIME_CDP_ORGANIZATION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact organization ID ending in @AdobeOrg.

credentialRequirements.name: ADOBE_REAL_TIME_CDP_SANDBOX_NAME
credentialRequirements.label: Adobe sandbox name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use one exact non-production sandbox binding.

capabilities.label: Read audiences and profiles
capabilities.description: List audience definitions or retrieve one exact profile with approval.

allowed.label: Read Adobe dataset metadata
allowed.description: List at most twenty bounded dataset metadata records.

approvalRequired.label: Read Adobe audiences or profile
approvalRequired.description: List bounded audience definitions or retrieve one exact profile.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth credentials, IMS tokens, organization and sandbox routing headers, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk transfers
blocked.description: Exports, destinations, ingestion, batches, files, pagination beyond the selected offset, multi-profile access, events, and responses above 1 MB are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Platform
blocked.description: Dataset, schema, profile, audience, identity, destination, source, policy, sandbox, permission, user, and project mutations remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only three pinned GET routes run on platform.adobe.io with fixed headers and bounds; arbitrary origins, paths, headers, queries, fields, and raw APIs are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded dataset metadata runs directly; audience definitions and one exact profile require approval while org, sandbox, field, page, and response bounds remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected reads run without Relay per-action approval; fixed IMS/API origins, exact org/sandbox binding, list/profile/field/response bounds, audits, and mutation/admin/bulk blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway exchanges Adobe IMS credentials server-side and mounts three bounded org- and sandbox-bound reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Adobe requires a customer-owned Developer Console project, OAuth Server-to-Server credential, Experience Platform product profile and attribute permissions, exact organization, and non-production sandbox. Profile Access also requires Real-Time CDP Ultimate. No console, project, account, credential, token, org, sandbox, data, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated staging project and least-privilege product profile outside this worker, configure the credential values in Railway staging, then verify token exchange, org/sandbox isolation, dataset/audience/profile reads, Ultimate-tier and attribute denial, approval denial/allow, field/page/response bounds, throttling, secret rotation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Adobe documents OAuth Server-to-Server as the supported method, API key and organization headers, sandbox requirements, product profiles, attribute permissions, and 24-hour access tokens.
Adobe documents client_credentials form POST to the fixed IMS v3 token endpoint, credential-provided scopes, expires_in, token caching, and throttling avoidance.
Adobe documents bounded Catalog dataSet listing with limit and properties filters.
Adobe documents GET segment definitions with start, limit, page and sort filters and required org/API/sandbox headers.
Adobe documents exact profile GET by schema, entity ID and namespace with explicit fields, and states Profile Access requires Real-Time CDP Ultimate.
